newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SCOTLAND V ESTONIA WORLD CUP TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCOTLAND V ESTONIA WORLD CUP TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for the World Cup group four soccer qualifier on Saturday between Scotland and Estonia.

Scotland: 1-Jim Leighton, 2-Craig Burley, 3-Tom Boyd, 4-Colin Calderwood, 5-Colin Hendry, 6-Tosh McKinlay, 7-Scot Gemmill, 8-Paul McStay, 9-Darren Jackson, 10-Gary McAllister (captain), 11-Kevin Gallacher.
Estonia: 1-Mart Poom, 2-Marek Lemsalu, 3-Udmas Kirs, 4-Sergei Hohlov-Simson, 5-Indrek Zelinski, 7-Janek Meet, 8-Mati Pari, 9-Marko Kristl, 10-Martin Reim, 11-Andres Oper, 17-Kristen Viikmae.
